test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Mahesh started from a point facing towards the west, turned left and walked for X m, then turned right and walked for 22 m, then turned left and walked for 11 m, and then turned left again and walked for 22 m. He is exactly 21 m away from the starting point. What is the value of X which was covered in the first leg of his journey?

(All turns are 90 degree turns only)
solution:
From the given information:

Mahesh started from a point facing towards the west, turned left and walked for X m, then turned right and walked for 22 m

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8cd47b876e8f40c8a470173cd3651525550a568c59c999b559ec2e02962f0775.png] 

Turn left and walked for 11 m, then turn left again and walked for 22 m.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bbd8c6ab9279166c0258bbbb0cbce681f3b4e5edf1b4b55d4468162a791d2f40.png] 

The value of X = 21 - 11 = 10m.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
